name: Notion MCP
what: Notion's hosted MCP server that lets AI tools search, read, create and update pages and databases you have access to in your Notion workspace.
who: Anyone keeping specs, notes or task lists in Notion who wants the AI to use them.

setup.text: Add the remote server. Claude Code (then run /mcp):
setup.code: claude mcp add --transport http notion https://mcp.notion.com/mcp

setup.text: Complete the OAuth flow to connect your workspace. Workspace members only; guests can't connect.
If your client only supports local servers:

prompts: Find my product spec page and turn it into a task list.
Create a Notion page summarizing today's changes.
Search my workspace for notes about pricing.
